items.author: Trump
items.text: HUGE INVESTMENT WIN for NEBRASKA AND THE U.S.!Beckton Dickenson (BD), one of the largest Medical Device Manufacturers, has agreed to an Investment of 3 BILLION DOLLARS to Onshore Manufacturing of Essential Medical Products (syringes, needles, lab kits, and more) that American Patients and Hospitals depend on. The biggest expansion will be in NEBRASKA (I am heading there today!) where BD will Invest over 1 BILLION DOLLARS to ramp up production of numerous products, including needles made with American Steel. No one likes needles — But, if you need one, it should be made of American Steel in the
items.summary_cn: Trump 强调 BD 将投资30亿美元扩大美国本土关键医疗产品生产，并称这是美国制造回流和供应链安全的重大胜利。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Wall Street says Elon Musk's Terafab talks with TSMC could spell bad news for Intel
items.summary_cn: 媒体称 Musk 旗下 Terafab 与 TSMC 的潜在合作可能削弱 Intel 的代工业务，凸显 AI 芯片制造竞争加剧。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk Is a Trillionaire Again Thanks to Recent Tesla, SpaceX Rally
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Tesla 和 SpaceX 近期上涨推动 Elon Musk 身家重回万亿美元级别，市场继续将 Musk 旗下资产视为高增长交易标的。

items.author: Burry
items.text: Michael Burry warns Wall Street has been inflating tech earnings by 42% for a decade — and you're paying for it
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Michael Burry 称华尔街过去十年将科技企业盈利虚增约42%，投资者正在为 AI 相关盈利质量支付过高价格。

items.author: Burry
items.text: Michael Burry's Bearish View. The Market Is In 'Denial' About The End Of The AI Trade.
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Michael Burry 看空 AI 交易，认为市场仍未充分意识到 AI 资产估值和商业周期的结束风险。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk’s xAI Wins Block of Minnesota’s AI ‘Nudification’ Ban
items.summary_cn: 媒体报道 xAI 在明尼苏达州针对人工智能图像生成监管的诉讼中胜诉，反映美国 AI 监管争议仍可能影响 AI 企业运营。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Musk says he will rename SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Musk 表示将 SpaceXAI 更名为 SpaceXSI，属于未上市 AI 与航天资产的战略整合或品牌调整。

items.author: Pelosi
items.text: Gridlock looms on congressional stock trade ban as parties clash over divestment
items.summary_cn: 报道称美国国会在国会议员股票交易禁令及资产剥离规则上陷入僵局，相关监管政策仍存在较大不确定性。

items.author: 洪灏
items.text: 環球經濟「O形環」現結構疲勞 市場集體裝睡
items.summary_cn: 相关评论认为全球经济呈 O 型环结构性疲劳且市场参与者对其风险缺乏警觉，构成偏空的宏观警示。

items.author: Trump
items.text: If Republicans win the House of Representatives and the Senate in the 2026 Midterm Elections, I’m going to give all Adult Citizens in the United States of America, $5,000. Thank you for your attention to this matter, and I look forward to signing those checks! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: Trump 宣称若共和党赢得2026年中期选举，将向美国成年公民每人发放5000美元，涉及潜在财政刺激和消费影响。

items.summary_cn: Trump 为 Johnny Garrett 竞选背书，提到减税、放松监管、扩大美国能源优势和推动 Made in USA 等政策议题。

items.author: Pelosi
items.text: Nancy Pelosi invests in commercial real estate via REOF XXX, LLC By Investing.com
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Nancy Pelosi 通过 REOF XXX LLC 参与商业地产投资，交易通过实体持有而非直接买入上市股票。

items.summary_cn: Trump 为 Chuck Gray 竞选背书，提及减税、放松监管、扩大能源优势和推动美国制造等政策方向。

items.summary_cn: Nancy Pelosi 的最新国会披露涉及一笔100万美元级非股票交易，交易性质并非公开市场股票买卖。
